about.label: Who We Are
about.title: About PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION
paragraphs: Founded in 2016 by Tosin AKANO, PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION is a non-governmental organisation committed to building stronger communities by empowering teenagers and caring for elderly people.

What began as a vision to mentor young people has grown into a movement of hope that now reaches families and communities across Nigeria and the United Kingdom — through education, advocacy, humanitarian outreach, and compassionate service.
We believe that honouring the elderly is not charity — it is a moral obligation. And that guiding a young person today shapes the world for decades to come.

featuredStory.label: Impact
featuredStory.pullQuote: I thank God and PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION for restoring my hope.
featuredStory.name: Mrs. Lawal Abeke
paragraphs: Mrs. Lawal Abeke was living with severe cataracts that took her independence. Through our medical outreach, she received a full eye examination, cataract surgery, and prescription glasses.
She can see her grandchildren again. Her story is one of hundreds — every pair of glasses, every surgery, every food pack is a life restored.

theNeed.label: Why We Exist
theNeed.line: By 2050, 2.1 billion people will be over 60 — and 80% of them will live in countries least equipped to care for them.
theNeed.interpretation: That's not a distant statistic. That's a mother, a father, a grandparent — someone's whole world.

programs.label: What We Do
programs.title: Our Programs

items.description: Mentoring teenagers to believe in their own worth. We help young people discover their value, build confidence, and develop the character that will carry them through life.

founder.label: Our Leader
founder.name: Tosin AKANO
paragraphs: In 2016, Tosin AKANO founded PHINEHAS GENERATION with a conviction: that every young person deserves guidance, and every elderly person deserves to be valued. Eight years later, that conviction still shapes every program we run.
What began as a passion to mentor teenagers has grown into a movement that empowers young people, restores dignity to senior citizens, and inspires communities to care for one another.

whereWeWork.label: Our Presence
whereWeWork.title: Where We Work
whereWeWork.subtitle: Two countries. Two generations. One mission that connects them.

paragraphs: Our strongest presence. Nigeria is where PHINEHAS GENERATION began, and it remains our primary focus for youth development. Through school outreach, mentorship programs, and leadership training, we are raising the next generation of ethical, capable Nigerian leaders.
We also serve elderly communities through medical outreach and welfare programs — because honouring the elderly is at the heart of everything we do.

In the UK, our focus is the elderly. Many older people in the UK face isolation, loneliness, and barriers to care. Through companionship programs, welfare support, and community outreach, we bring dignity and connection to those who have given so much to society.
We also work with young people through mentorship and educational support — because every generation deserves hope.

items.q: What does PHINEHAS GENERATION FOUNDATION do?
items.a: We are a non-governmental organisation that empowers teenagers and cares for elderly people. Our work spans mentorship, education, medical outreach, food support, and community welfare — across Nigeria and the United Kingdom.
We operate in Nigeria (with a focus on youth development) and the United Kingdom (with a focus on elderly care). Across both countries, we serve both generations — because the need exists everywhere.
There are three main ways: Give (donate to support our programs), Volunteer (give your time and skills), or Share (tell others about our work). Visit our Volunteer page or Contact page to learn more.
Yes. All donations are processed through secure, industry-standard payment channels. We are committed to transparency and accountability in everything we do.

items.q: Can I volunteer from outside Nigeria or the UK?
items.a: Yes. We welcome remote volunteers who can contribute skills such as design, writing, social media management, translation, or administrative support. Visit our Volunteer page for current opportunities.
